column1: # Rules in omp-port/rules.sed that earlier rules starve, kept as they are for now, one per line as
# `left-hand-fragment<TAB>reason`. `rule shadowing` feeds each dead rule's own raw upstream matches
# through every rule above it; when they come out changed, an earlier rule rewrites this rule's text
# first and this one never fires while that order stands. A duplicate lands here, and so does a
# narrower rule placed above a broader one, which is how rule 228 at 4275556 shipped dead. The
# fragment is matched as a literal substring of the rule's own line, as in stale-exempt.tsv.
